stage: Prospective binding configuration only; no candidate or instrumented product exists or has been executed.
purpose: Make owner-local passive test telemetry visible across the core dependency boundary of the infra test executable, without a product feature, default mode or additional production API.

instrumented_configuration.target_directory_policy: Fresh task-specific mktemp directory under /tmp, separate from ordinary candidate and baseline targets; actual absolute path recorded in build receipt.
instrumented_configuration.propagation: Apply the explicit cfg to both core and infra compilation, including core as dependency. Do not presume cfg(test) propagates through Cargo dependencies.
instrumented_configuration.configuration_transport: Record actual encoded rustflags, environment delta, commands, source pins and exact emitted executable paths/hashes in the compiled configuration consumed by the frozen phase-F driver.

ordinary_configuration.public_candidate_and_workspace_gates: Run without the custom cfg; ordinary build must expose only the approved productive interface.

binding_constraints: Activation requires independent seal plus actual phase-D RED; this declaration is not implementation authorization by itself.
Only conditional owner-local telemetry and access to actual retained records are permitted; no new owner, productive API, feature or default.
Use per-instance pure storage in core; no global mutable state, registry, filesystem, clock or environment reads in productive L1 paths.
Hooks observe the real producer, capture, style chain, request, replay, attempt and sink transitions. They must not implement a parallel pipeline or execute bodies, folds or callbacks for telemetry.
Expected values, case classification and oracle predicates never enter the productive port or determine execution.
Binding may transport driver-provided provenance only inside test harnesses, not into product decisions.

Before runtime credit, the independent verifier audits effective per-crate cfgs, source/call graph, absence of hooks in ordinary build and equivalence of algorithm and routes between ordinary and instrumented configurations.
Exact hook layout and names remain late-bound under R3; no change to frozen fixture DTOs, assertions or semantic obligations is authorized.
seal_requirement: Pin this configuration and its independent acceptance before the seal. Future source/build receipts and binding audit must establish implementation of these constraints; the declaration earns no runtime or coverage credit.
